connectors.use_case: Finding which pages got the most visitors this month, checking the Google searches the site appears for, asking the developers to add a new team page.

connectors.name: xispark
connectors.description: Builds, edits, translates and publishes landing pages, audits page SEO, writes and publishes blog and community posts, manages mini-store products and books, uploads images, connects owned domains, reads referral stats and affiliate earnings, and lets invited Xispark Academy teachers build courses and lessons.
connectors.use_case: Generating a landing page for an ebook launch and publishing it, connecting an owned domain to the page, checking this month's affiliate earnings.

connectors.name: xSpeed Cache WordPress
connectors.description: Purges page, object and Cloudflare caches across WordPress sites, checks cache health and hit ratio, runs PageSpeed tests and benchmarks, updates module settings, and applies tested optimizations with rollback or as a dry run.
connectors.use_case: Purging the cache on a blog after a theme change, finding which site has the worst hit ratio, running a dry-run optimization on a slow store.

connectors.name: Ycode
connectors.description: Creates and edits Ycode Cloud websites the user has designer access to, including pages, layers, components, styles, CMS collections, redirects, translations and assets, reads form submissions, imports HTML and publishes changes, asking for confirmation before publishing or deleting anything.
connectors.use_case: Converting a Tailwind HTML mockup into editable Ycode layers, adding a blog collection with dynamic pages, translating the homepage into Spanish.

connectors.name: YesHello
connectors.description: Builds YesHello digital business cards, lead forms and service catalogs from a website or scratch, edits fields and services, publishes them and reads submissions and analytics.
connectors.use_case: Building a card for a cleaning business from its website, adding a quote form with three services.

connectors.name: ZenTables
connectors.description: Creates embeddable website tables from Google Sheet links that stay in sync with the sheet, lists existing tables, returns HTML embed code and restyles tables with one of six color themes.
connectors.use_case: Turning a price-list Google Sheet into a table for a Webflow site, switching a job-board table to the Ocean theme.
